newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar off highs in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar off highs in featureless trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures came off highs in featureless afternoon trading, with New York setting the tone.
Earlier in the day one big buyer had helped push prices up, but disappointment at New York's lackluster early trading helped bring prices back, traders said.
"Now New York's going up again, London will probably follow it," one trader said. Others felt that producer selling into the rise would limit gains.
By 1600 GMT active March was up $0.40 to $309.50, having reached a high of $310.30 earlier in the day. March had by then traded 985 lots of a total 1,267.
Traders were happier with the level of activity than they have been for much of this holiday week. "At least we've got some decent volume," one said.
